messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered — error rate 8.3% (5m) on lyrahealth-prod-vpc canary group (dedicated pool). Affected: 1 tenant (lyrahealth). Severity: P1. Paging primary on-call.

maria_sre: Got the page, I'm on it. Observing 502 spikes and downstream 10s latency on shard-3. Can confirm canary traffic only.

chris_runtime: I see the same in runtime tracing — KV cache miss rate jumped for canary instances after the last artifact (sha: b7f4c9). Requests are dying during model load. Attaching snippet of pod logs.

maria_sre: Please paste the tail.

chris_runtime: ```
2026-03-15T14:42:10Z model_load ERROR failed to mmap weights: invalid argument
2026-03-15T14:42:11Z runtime WARN falling back to CPU for shard-3
2026-03-15T14:42:12Z inference ERROR client disconnected mid-stream
```

akshay_support: Customer-reported 30% of requests time out; they're seeing degraded UX. LyraHealth support has been looped in (they're watching). We should treat this as customer-impacting.

devon_account: I'm on stand-up with their ops lead now, telling them we have engineers engaged and will update them every 15m. They asked if we can quarantine the tenant while we mitigate.

maria_sre: Given model_load failures and the fact this is a canary rollout with pinned artifact b7f4c9, recommend immediate pinback to previous artifact (a4d1b2) for canary hosts, and isolate lyrahealth tenant from the canary slice to the stable pool until we verify.

chris_runtime: Agreed. Plan: 1) Divert lyrahealth traffic off canary 2) Pin canary artifact back to a4d1b2 3) Recycle affected canary hosts 4) Monitor. I can run the pin command.

maria_sre: Pair with deploy-bot to execute pin and then handoff.

deploy-bot: Received request to pin artifact for canary group "canary-lyra-2026" -> executing. Command: `redwood deploy pin --group canary-lyra-2026 --artifact a4d1b2`

deploy-bot: Pin successful. New pinned artifact: a4d1b2. Starting host drain and rolling restart for canary instances (parallelism=2). Progress updates will stream here. :gear:

oncall-handoff-bot: Handoff note: maria_sre is primary until 15:05 UTC, then chris_runtime takes on-call. Include this thread in the incident summary.

maria_sre: Initiating tenant isolation: moving lyrahealth routing key off canary slice to stable-1. Command: `routingctl move-tenant --tenant lyrahealth --from canary-lyra-2026 --to stable-1 --drain-timeout 30s`

deploy-bot: Tenant move accepted. Drain started. Current requests draining: 6.

chris_runtime: After pin, I'm seeing model loads succeed on fresh canary instances. KV miss rate dropping. Can we speed up host recycle? We have 4 failing canary hosts; restarting now.

maria_sre: Restarting those four. Quick check: are we still seeing 502s for lyrahealth now that they're on stable pool? akshay_support?

akshay_support: LyraHealth reports immediate improvement — timeouts gone, but occasional latency blips (1 in 100). They want a postmortem. I'll capture timeline and keep them apprised.

maria_sre: Good. I'll keep the incident open and run a short regression test suite against lyrahealth endpoints. Chris — can you leave canary pinned to a4d1b2 for 2 hours and then we can re-evaluate?

chris_runtime: Yes pin retention 2h set. I'll also create an artifact ticket to investigate b7f4c9 build differences (quantization step may have changed).

lisa_prod: Noted. I'll create a rollback RCA ticket and schedule a joint postmortem with Release and Runtime. Please include perf diffs for the artifact.

maria_sre: Summarizing mitigation: paged, confirmed failure on canary artifact b7f4c9, pinned canary back to a4d1b2, isolated lyrahealth to stable pool, recycled failing hosts, monitoring stable metrics. Customer impacted but restored.

oncall-handoff-bot: Please add incident tag: lyrahealth-vpc-canary-rollback-20260315.

maria_sre: Closing this thread for active remediation — we'll keep monitoring for 2 hours. If errors spike again, re-open with @chris_runtime and escalate to eng-runtime.

akshay_support: Adding follow-up notes for customer: ETA for RCA 48 hours. Thanks team. :heart:

deploy-bot: Rolling restart completed. Can confirm 0/4 failing canary hosts remain.

maria_sre: Last check: error rate back to baseline 0.2%. Moving incident to MONITORING. Updating PD.

chris_runtime: Creating artifact investigation ticket: ARTIFACT-2247. Will include reproducer and quantization logs.

devon_account: I'll send the customer the runbook summary and the internal incident reference.

maria_sre: Great work, everyone.
